opportunities.description: Battery holders, audio cables and USB cables are mixed across bins; one bin labeled 'Buzzers' is mostly hidden.

Right-hand section has a large open area of mat between the flux packs and the solder spool.
Lower strip of both halves has free mat space; drawer holds only mats and clamps.
